map.输入年租金收入、空置率、运营费用率、贷款本息及租金年增长率，预测未来多年 NOI: Enter annual rental income, vacancy rate, operating expense ratio, loan principal and interest and annual rent growth to forecast NOI, pre-tax cash flow and cumulative net cash flow over future years.
map.📖 查看「现金流预测 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Cash Flow Forecast User Guide"
map.现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本支出: Cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditure
map.年贷款本息（万元，选填）: Annual loan principal and interest (¥10,000, optional)
map.💡 有效毛收入 EGI = GPR × (1 − 空置率)；NOI = EGI: 💡 Effective gross income EGI = GPR × (1 − vacancy rate); NOI = EGI − operating expenses; pre-tax cash flow = NOI − loan principal and interest; income tax is not considered.
map.贷款本息为固定年值，未考虑逐年本金递减: Loan principal and interest is a fixed annual amount and does not reflect principal declining year by year
map.运营费用率因物业类型差异较大，写字楼/商业通常 20%–35%: Operating expense ratios vary widely by property type; offices and retail usually run 20%-35%
map.增长率假设对远期现金流影响显著，建议分保守/中性/乐观情景: Growth assumptions strongly affect distant cash flows, so model conservative, base and optimistic cases
map.未考虑资本性支出（CAPEX）与大修准备金: Capital expenditure (CAPEX) and major repair reserves are not included
map.持有型物业做多年现金流预测表。: Build a multi-year cash flow table for a held property.
map.算首年 NOI 与累计税前现金流。: Compute first-year NOI and cumulative pre-tax cash flow.
map.租金增长与贷款本息对回款的影响。: See how rent growth and debt service affect cash recovery.
map.首年 GPR 120 万、空置 8% → EGI=110.4 万；运营费 25%: First-year GPR of 1.2 million yuan with 8% vacancy gives EGI of 1.104 million; operating expenses at 25% give NOI of 828,000; annual debt service of 300,000 gives pre-tax cash flow of 528,000; NOI is 69% of GPR.
map.租金年增 2%、持有 10 年 → 累计 NOI 随增长放大；税前现金流=各年(: With 2% annual rent growth over a 10-year hold, cumulative NOI compounds with growth; pre-tax cash flow is the sum of (NOI − 30) each year, used to judge cash recovery over the holding period.
map.现金流和 NOI 区别？: How do cash flow and NOI differ?
map.NOI 是运营层面净收益，税前现金流再扣贷款本息，反映股东/投资人实际到手。: NOI is net income at the operating level; pre-tax cash flow then deducts debt service and shows what the owner or investor actually takes home.
map.住宅 2%–3%、商业 3%–5%，需结合通胀与租约递增条款，过高会虚增估值。: 2%-3% for housing and 3%-5% for commercial, tied to inflation and lease escalation clauses; setting it too high inflates the valuation.
map.房地产投资现金流预测工具，基于潜在毛租金、空置损失、运营费用、贷款本息与租金增长: A property investment cash flow forecaster: from potential gross rent, vacancy loss, operating expenses, debt service and rent growth it projects NOI and pre-tax cash flow year by year, helping judge cash recovery over the holding period.
map.持有期现金流规划: Cash flow planning over the holding period
